findings.summary: Distinct settlement IDs can settle one request twice; proxy sends actual_cost zero.
Admission identity and mutation endpoints are unauthenticated; HTTPS/webhook failure can bypass enforcement.
No dispatch/expiry/late-settlement/window lifecycle or requested risk allocation/quantile/drift behavior exists.
Feasibility omits readiness, routability, quality, approval, sovereignty, pricing freshness and objective.
Release workflow/chart omit required GOV-AR image and PostgreSQL production support; measured-path tests are absent.
PostgreSQL tenant IDs are global while caller-selected namespaced policies can overwrite their budgets.
The e2e test mutates the current Kubernetes context before its Kind image-load step defaults to cluster kind.
The generator now parses every CRD version and maps controllers only through exact primary For watches; independent recomputation matched every regenerated inventory row.

note: Pass means the recovery audit is source-complete and reproducible; implementation findings remain mandatory Phase D work.
